prompt_instructions: Attach the original image to preserve mascot pose, voucher placement, and the headline scale.
Keep all visible text exactly as shown.
Maintain the playful social-promo energy and the glowing yellow city background.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square be x URBOX social minigame poster with a glowing yellow city background and curved blue foreground floor. Place the be and URBOX logos at the top left. Add the large blue headline 'Minigame đua bình luận Nhận voucher UrBox 2 TRIỆU'. Show a large smartphone on the right with the yellow be app icon on screen, and a smiling illustrated be mascot jumping beside it. Surround the scene with floating purple voucher cards, a red chat-bubble icon, and a heart-eyes laughing emoji in the lower left. Technical style: illustrated social engagement poster, bright playful graphic lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark colors, wrong logos, incorrect text, missing vouchers, low resolution, distorted mascot, clutter, watermark, signature
